title: A/P Summary: a blank bucket cell stays at the bottom in both sort orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Create, for this test, a vendor, vendor A, with one unpaid bill of $100.00 that is 10 days past due on today's date, so its "1-30 Days" cell reads $100.00.
  • Create, for this test, a vendor, vendor B, with one unused vendor credit of $50.00 dated 10 days ago, so its "1-30 Days" cell reads $-50.00.
  • Create, for this test, a vendor, vendor C, whose name is more than 60 characters long, with spaces, and includes each of these characters: & " ' < >, with one unpaid bill dated today that is not yet due, so its "1-30 Days" cell is blank.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only vendor A, vendor B and vendor C ticked in the Vendor filter.
custom_steps:
1. Take a screenshot of the page, showing the column headings.
  2. Click the "1-30 Days" header.
  3. Click the "1-30 Days" header again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Vendor A's "1-30 Days" cell reads $100.00, vendor B's reads $-50.00 and vendor C's is blank.
  • Vendor C's whole name shows exactly as typed, with its & " ' < > characters, and wraps inside its own cell without running into the next column.

Step 2:

  • The rows read vendor A ($100.00), then vendor B ($-50.00), then vendor C (blank) at the bottom: largest first, the blank cell last.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Step 3:

  • The rows read vendor B ($-50.00), then vendor A ($100.00), then vendor C (blank), still at the bottom.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 13 (13 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 13 Nov 2026, version re-checked 14 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R6: “A blank value (for example a vendor credit on A/P Unpaid Invoices, which has no due date and no Past Due) sorts to the bottom of its group in both directions. On A/P Detail a vendor credit shows its own date as its due date, as today, so it is not blank there.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

References from Design
